2610.06790.title: Back to the Future: Rethinking EDA Infrastructure for Agentic Systems in Chip Design Verification
2610.06790.paper_summary: The unprecedented computational scale of modern artificial intelligence depends on complex, multi-billion-transistor Systems-on-Chip, yet the workflows that verify these chips remain stubbornly manual. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have made rapid inroads into Electronic Design Automation (EDA), approximately 74.6% of existing studies target static Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code generation, leaving post-simulation verification and interactive waveform debugging largely untouched. We introduce Back-to-the-Future (BTTF), an end-to-end agentic framework that closes this infrastructural gap. BTTF distills massive, unstructured simulation dumps into a normalized relational SQLite database and couples it with a collaborative multi-agent orchestration engine that translates natural-language verification queries into schema-aware SQL while correlating signal anomalies with versioned RTL repositories. Across a 150-query benchmark, BTTF attains 95.33% execution accuracy, charting a practical path toward autonomous EDA verification.
2610.06790.paper_summary_zh: 當代人工智慧前所未有的計算規模依賴於複雜的數十億晶體管系統單晶片，但驗證這些晶片的工作流程仍然固執地手動進行。儘管大型語言模型（LLMs）在電子設計自動化（EDA）領域迅速取得進展，但約74.6%的現有研究針對靜態寄存器傳輸級（RTL）代碼生成，留下了模擬後驗證和互動波形調試幾乎未被觸及。我們介紹了“回到未來”（BTTF），這是一個端到端的代理框架，旨在填補這一基礎設施空白。BTTF將大量非結構化的模擬轉儲提煉為標準化的關聯SQLite數據庫，並將其與協作的多代理編排引擎相結合，該引擎將自然語言驗證查詢轉換為具架構意識的SQL，同時將信號異常與版本化的RTL存儲庫相關聯。在150個查詢基準測試中，BTTF達到了95.33%的執行準確率，為自主EDA驗證描繪了一條實際的道路。
